original_target.title: The Eisenbud-Goto regularity bound for smooth complex projective varieties

scope_comparison: Theorem A in 2601.16103 requires a 2-very-ample projectively normal embedding and specified mild singularities; smoothness alone does not supply projective normality. The October paper explicitly retains the smooth Eisenbud–Goto question and treats secant loci/linear syzygies and singular examples. Ideal-sheaf versus structure-sheaf regularity has been distinguished.
